canonical.fingerprintAlgorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit over NFKD-normalized, lowercase, punctuation-normalized ASCII fields; options sorted before option hash; concept hash combines category, topic and stem tokens.

officialPyq.layout: 24-byte little-endian records: fileIndex:u8, questionNumber:u16, stemHash:u32, optionsHash:u32, answerHash:u32, topicHash:u32, conceptHash:u32, statusCode:u8

candidateScan.method: Normalized stem token Jaccard screening (flag threshold 0.22), order-insensitive sorted option-set fingerprints, and manual topic/concept/learning-objective review; no embedding model used.
